name: Mission La Purísima Concepción
aka: La Purísima Mission State Historic Park

dates.note: The survey's own words: 'Buildings on the original ait© between 1783 and 1812. Structures on the new and present site built 1812 to possibly 1830'. Because the survey itself will not fix a completion year, the style node's exemplar carries no year rather than an invented one. The buildings standing today are largely a 1930s Civilian Conservation Corps reconstruction, which the survey describes as 'New construction ... of the same materials as original buildings' with concrete foundations and concrete columns and bond beams built into the adobe walls.

note: Seeded 5 Sep 2026 as the node's DOCUMENTARY case — the most completely reconstructed mission, state-owned, with the survey stating plainly what was original and what was rebuilt. THE SURVEY STATES NO OVERALL DIMENSION, which is the pattern across every 1930s California mission sheet read for this cluster: they record ownership, dates, materials and condition, and leave the sizes to the measured drawings. The one storey with a loft over parts of the Residence Building is the only count it gives.
